messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.

By what date is the Commission required to adopt the delegated acts referred to in Article 6(11) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which concern the common methodology for the data that Member States must provide?

response.text: Entro quale data la Commissione è tenuta ad adottare gli atti delegati di cui all'articolo 6, paragrafo 11, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, relativi alla metodologia comune per i dati che gli Stati membri devono fornire?
